topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: The walls that held my days suddenly whisper change, a tide turning, washing away the sureness of my steps. These halls, marked with the tread of countless mornings, now echo with the murmurs of new plans, of new faces. The door that knew my hand, the light that welcomed my return, these are to shift, to belong to hands I do not know. The air is thick with promises of what will be, but I taste only the faint sadness of what slips through my fingers. Tonight, the shadows stretch longer, and the silence speaks of empty spaces where my steps once found home.
